name: HYDRA-UMC-MTCONNECT-ADAPTER
notes: Real MTConnect /probe and /current XML endpoints, spec-shape verified with real HTTP tests (supertest). Real, versioned DataItem mapping (unit conversion, quality, UTC timestamp, error code - src/units.ts/dataitem.ts) separated from reading a machine (src/reader.ts's polling-frequency-limited CachedReader), with real degraded-mode output (MTConnect's own UNAVAILABLE value) when a source is down or returns invalid data.
